title: Ride the California Zephyr through the Rockies
description: Board Amtrak’s California Zephyr in Denver and let the train climb toward the Continental Divide before following the Colorado River through canyon country. From a window seat, watch tunnels, peaks, and river bends replace the city; Glenwood Springs makes a natural stop. The changing view gives the trip its rhythm, without asking you to drive mountain roads.
teaser: Let the Rockies unfold between Denver and Glenwood Springs.
goodToKnow: Reserve suitable seating; allow for railway delays.
whyItMightDelightYou: It is one of those journeys where sitting still feels like the most rewarding way to travel.
